g.text: Objects move between access tiers as access patterns change
The Nix binary cache preserves packages that are at least a decade old—software that in some cases has vanished from the Internet.
These packages can still be rebuilt today on modern systems using their required dependencies.
• A single S3 bucket in us-east-1 holds NARs, narinfo, logs and realisations
• Intelligent-Tiering moves objects to cheaper tiers as access drops off—and back
• Fastly CDN provides global caching and streaming capabilities
• Clients reach cache.nixos.org over HTTPS at the Fastly edge, never S3 directly
